properties.accuracyNote: The four lots the Notice of Preparation and Draft EIR name for Freedom West 2.0 (case 2020-006887ENV), against the Draft EIR's 451,500 sq ft (10.37 acres): the whole block between McAllister and Fulton streets and most of the block to the north. Lot 0770/027 also takes in the corner of McAllister and Laguna streets at 870-880 McAllister Street, a separate 115-home senior housing project (case 2024-003742PRJ) that the Draft EIR leaves out of the site; the lot split approved in 2024 (case 2024-008030SUB) isn't in the parcel layer yet, so that corner, about 0.4 acres, is drawn as part of the site. Bethel A.M.E. Church and 967-973 Golden Gate Avenue are on their own lots and aren't drawn. 10.8 acres as drawn.
